title: Retire unambiguous cancelled MCP trace entries when their response dispatch is proven
outcome: Retire unambiguous cancelled MCP trace entries when their response dispatch is proven
acceptance: A safely attributable single-generation cancelled call releases its retained trace slot and emits any withheld summary when its response dispatch is observed; repeated completed cancellation lifecycles do not exhaust the shared tracking pool.

Duplicate, token-cancelled, missing-receive and otherwise ambiguous generations remain conservatively uncorrelated; deterministic regression coverage proves that slot retirement never lets an old response claim a replacement call.

completion.summary: Unambiguous cancelled MCP trace entries are retired when their response dispatch is done; landed (in the ancestry of e7426a6) and verified on the Windows B gate bundle test-fdd408e3. An independent acceptance evaluation passed both criteria (record 8ce103752fe548e09a5aff4c92810532).
